# Blewett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P15](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Mrs. Blewett is a small, sharp-faced woman with sharp eyes and a shrewish expression. She is extremely thin, lacking any superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013)_

## Personality

Blewett is known for a shrewish, stingy, and bad-tempered demeanor. Discharged servant girls have shared fearsome accounts regarding her harsh temper and parsimonious nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_
